source: docs/design/balance-sheet.md section 5.1 (pace.rateMultiplier 1.0 standard, 4.0 classroom; group.size 1 solo, teacher sets 3-5 in classroom, 4 is the balance sheet's reference group) and section 1 (a sol is 24,000 ticks, 20 minutes). Hold lengths (3/7/14 sols standard, 1/2/3 classroom, section 4) live in the gate files, not here. There is deliberately no threshold in this file: physical thresholds never scale (invariant I-1). The group size ranges (standard 1 to 5, classroom 3 to 5) and the classroom default of 4 are choices, not sourced numbers. The classroom range of 3 to 5 is a design choice aligned with the Decision Log group of 3 to 5 (owner accepted the Instructional Designer's recommendation: a group of 1 or 2 in classroom mode would break the shared-planet group rates); standard keeps 1 to 5. creative_gate_bypass is a design choice (owner, slice 9): the creative and admin route stays in standard play and is off in classroom, where the operator command /mars gate latch is the only way past a gate.
